chunks: And from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
Anyone of our Shi'ah who is afflicted by Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) with a trial and bears it with patience shall have the reward of one thousand martyrs.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a believer who patiently endures a trial from Allah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Hasan (a.s.) states that any member of the Shi'a who endures a divine trial with patience is granted the reward equivalent to that of one thousand martyrs. This highlights the high spiritual status of patience (sabr) in the face of affliction.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 8. It has been narrated that Abu al-Hasan (a.s) said: “
Anyone of our Shi'ah who is afflicted by Allah with a trial and bears it with patience shall have the reward of one thousand martyrs.”
